error[ZBX-E0902]: a key with that name already exists
  cause  a key named 'ci' is already in /home/alice/.config/zbx/keys; zbx never
         overwrites a key
  fix    choose another name:   zbx key new <name>
  more   zbx explain E0902 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0902.html
